welcome:
`gYou step into the serene, incense-scented training space. Your Master stands with crossed arms in the middle of the mat.`w

"Welcome, traveler. I see you have fought in the forest. But are you truly ready for the next step?"
status_req: Required XP for Level {nextLvl}: `c{reqXp} XP`w (Current: `c{currentXp} XP`w)
ready: `2You are ready to fight for your next level!`w
not_ready: `4You haven't earned enough experience to challenge me yet. Train harder in the forest!`w
victory: `2Congratulations! You defeated your Master and ascend to Level {lvl}! Your max HP is permanently increased to {maxHp}.`w
defeat: `4Your Master beats you black and blue on the mat with a wooden training sword: "You are not ready yet, apprentice!" You barely survive, your HP is set to 1.`w
